title: FlagCalculatorResponse
description: Result of a POST /flag-calculator call: how many flags were created, updated, and deactivated, plus the resulting total. All four counters are 0 when the workflow's status is REVIEWED_BY_CERTIFYOS, since flag evaluation is skipped for that status.

flagsCreated.description: Number of flags newly created during this evaluation. Non-negative integer; 0 when the workflow's status is REVIEWED_BY_CERTIFYOS (no-op path).

flagsUpdated.description: Number of existing flags whose state changed during this evaluation. Non-negative integer; 0 when the workflow's status is REVIEWED_BY_CERTIFYOS (no-op path).

flagsDeactivated.description: Number of previously active flags deactivated during this evaluation. Non-negative integer; 0 when the workflow's status is REVIEWED_BY_CERTIFYOS (no-op path).

totalFlags.description: Total number of active flags on the workflow after this evaluation completed. Non-negative integer; 0 when the workflow's status is REVIEWED_BY_CERTIFYOS (no-op path).

monitoringWorkflowId.description: ID of the monitoring workflow this result belongs to; echoes the monitoringWorkflowId from the request.
